sections.content: The tag creates hyperlinks with href pointing to a URL; embeds images with src. Both are void-ish elements — wraps content, stands alone.
Always add alt text to images (accessibility + SEO), and use target="_blank" to open links in a new tab when appropriate.
Key points: relative vs absolute URLs, # links jump to page sections via id, and images need width/height hints to avoid layout shift.
